name: Snare
author: E. T. Carter
description: An orbit-trap Julia set: 40-step iteration grazing a thin rotating cross fills the dark with infinitely nested, warped ghost-images of that single unseen trap. The seed orbits inside the cardioid and the cross slowly turns, so the whole filigree re-inks itself in place — nothing travels, the boundary writhes.

params.label: Writhe speed
params.effect: Orbit speed of the hidden seed, i.e. how quickly the whole filigree re-inks itself.

params.label: Trap spin
params.effect: Rotation rate of the unseen cross — every echo in the frame shears and re-aims together as it turns.

params.label: Trap thickness
params.effect: Arm thickness of the trap, from hairline crosses everywhere to soft fat blooms.

params.label: Filigree gain
params.effect: Brightness gain on the trapped-distance falloff, lifting more or fewer of the deep nested echoes into visibility.
